name: 経路沿いのカテゴリ一覧
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Render exactly ONE Lighthouse component LH01-0005 経路沿いのカテゴリ一覧, six category actions in a3column by2row grid.
REFERENCE PRIORITY: input1 ORIGINAL source image controls glyph anatomy/proportions, optical weight, alignment/spacing and fine details. Relevant crop x32 y371 width1112 height465. Input2 rough mock is secondary for exact Japanese wording and grid layout only. Its thin outline substitutes are inaccurate: use source's strong clean filled glyph silhouettes. Input3 approved Lighthouse bus is style only, not its content.
Six equal white rounded action tiles, top row: original filled gasoline pump icon with hose above "ガソリン"; original fork-and-knife glyph above "食事"; original filled coffee cup/handle with separate saucer line above "カフェ". Bottom row: original filled grocery cart/basket with two wheels above "買い物"; original two standing man/woman restroom figures above "休憩所"; original filled bed/headboard/pillow silhouette above "宿泊". Preserve all6original glyphs and exact3×2ordering. No substituted bench/pin/outline bed or malformed vector details.
Accent decision: original uses one consistent blue for ALL six actionable category glyphs and labels. Adapt that coherent action group to ONE Lighthouse forest-green #1F6444 for all6glyphs and all6labels. Do not assign different colors by topic. No selected tile, mint fill or six filled green cards. Other supporting outlines/borders neutral.
Pure-white #FFFFFF page and tile surfaces; fine neutral borders, modest12px logical corners, extremely soft restrained shadow, compact consistent gaps and centered glyph/label spacing. Keep all actions equal and unselected. Meiryo Regular14/24 labels, zero tracking, one line each, no bold. Uniformly scale logical390px component. High-resolution landscape about3:2 with modest white margins. Only the six-tile component: exclude source search field, recent results, keyboard, device chrome and logos. No invented text/control.
reviewNotes: 原参照を優先し6種の塗りつぶしカテゴリ図形、3列2段、全日本語ラベルを保持。原の一貫した青の操作グループを一色の森林緑へ適用。白面と余計な項目なしを確認。ただし全ラベルが指定のMeiryo Regularより太く見えるため修正。所有者承認・編集可能性・実装ではない。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
